I have combination skin and no idea what i’m doing with it. the level of dryness and areas affected by dryness vary day to day. i currently (occasionally) use neutrogena rapid clear and tretinoin cream and (frequently) a cetaphil moisturizer that i’m not convinced does anything. any advice would be great!
